popup.title: Vintage & Used Guitar Shops in Greater Austin
popup.subtitle: A Product Intelligence Report
popup.body: 9 guitar shops are profiled in this report. Types covered include dedicated vintage specialists, a boutique luthier showroom, an acoustic-only specialist, full-line independents, and national chain outlets. Austin Vintage Guitars on Red River Street and South Austin Music on South Lamar — in business since 1986 — are two highlighted locations from the report.

popup.title: Austin Vintage Guitars
popup.subtitle: 4306 Red River St · Hyde Park corridor
popup.body: Austin's flagship dedicated vintage shop, under the same ownership since the late 1990s. Inventory skews toward pre-CBS Fenders, vintage Gibsons, period-correct amps, and effects — with Reverb listings that reach buyers nationwide. Full repair bench on-site.

popup.title: South Austin Music
popup.subtitle: 1402 S Lamar Blvd · South Austin · Est. 1986
popup.body: Austin's longest-running independent guitar shop — on the same South Lamar corner since 1986. Known for a treasure-hunt mix of characterful mid-range instruments, used American Fenders, quirky off-brand finds, and in-house repairs. Lessons available on-site.
